backend_modal.title: Dedicated Engine Node Setup
backend_modal.subtitle: Unlock SolidWorks, Inventor & IFC Native B-Rep Sewing & Heavy Model Translation
backend_modal.hf_step_title: Setup your Free Hugging Face Spaces Node
backend_modal.hf_step3: In the Space repository, link this GitHub repo or upload app.py & requirements.txt
backend_modal.hf_step4: Once deployed, copy your Space Direct URL (e.g., https://username-omniseam.hf.space) and paste below
backend_modal.client_desc: In this mode, all 3D mesh algorithms, defect repairs, topological checks, and format conversions (STL, OBJ, 3MF, PLY, GLTF/GLB) run strictly inside your browser via WebAssembly and Web Workers. Your 3D models never leave your computer, ensuring total privacy and $0 cost.
backend_modal.client_limitation: Note: Proprietary CAD formats (.sldprt, .sldasm, .ipt, .ifc) require a Python FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE server node for exact B-Rep tessellation.

cad_unlock.title: Native CAD Format Unlock
cad_unlock.desc_1: You uploaded a proprietary native CAD format (such as SolidWorks, Inventor, or IFC). These closed B-Rep formats require FreeCAD and OpenCASCADE to perform boundary representation sewing and exact surface tessellation.
cad_unlock.desc_2: You can choose either of the following solutions:
cad_unlock.opt1_title: Option A: Connect Free Hugging Face Dedicated Space
cad_unlock.opt1_desc: Launch your own FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE node on Hugging Face Spaces (16GB RAM · Free) in 1 minute to unlock full cloud translation.
cad_unlock.opt2_title: Option B: Export as STEP / STL / OBJ in your CAD software
cad_unlock.opt2_desc: If you prefer 100% offline in-browser processing with zero server dependencies, export your CAD file as STEP, STL, OBJ, or 3MF before uploading.
